label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 23
title: MVP: PWA support for the dashboard web app (installable, offline shell, push)
body: Current web is NOT PWA as-is (dashboard/ = server.py + static/index.html; no manifest/service worker). Add web app manifest + service worker so the web app is installable and works on mobile-web, covering the deferred native mobile app.
